versions.content: If the optional configuration parameter FRIF_E_ACS_CH_A ex- ists, then the channel status information shall be reported to DEM as Dem_SetEvent Status (FRIF_E_ACS_CH_A , DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREFAILED) when any of the error bits of a single controller (Channel A aggregated channel status vSS!SyntaxEr- ror, vSS!ContentError, vSS!Bviolation, vSS!TxConflict) is set or as Dem_SetEventSta- tus (FRIF_E_ACS_CH_A, DEM_EVENT_STATUS_PREPASSED) when none of these error bits is set.
